$comment: Agent tool-schema manifest for bobby-cli. See specs/09-spec-agent-tool-schema.md. This file is read-only data — never run as a server. Every invocation spawns a fresh `bobby-cli` subprocess; no shared connection or shared state across calls. Keep in sync with src/commands/auth.ts and src/commands/memory.ts whenever a command or flag changes. INVOCATION SAFETY (see specs/09-spec-agent-tool-schema.md § Invocation safety): `invocation` strings are illustrative only. An executor MUST build an argv array (e.g. child_process.execFile/spawn with an args array) and substitute each {placeholder} as its own argv element — never run the template through a shell or string-concatenate it, or a value containing spaces/quotes/shell metacharacters (especially {password}) can break argument boundaries or inject commands. An optional field that has no value MUST have its flag and value omitted entirely from argv — do not substitute an empty string (e.g. `--tags {tags}` with no tags becomes just `--tags`, which would incorrectly consume the next argv token).

tools.name: auth_login
tools.description: Log in to auth-center and mint a session-memory API token, stored locally in ~/.bobby-cli/credentials.json. Only needs to be run once per machine/agent identity, not before every memory call. Prefer BOBBY_CLI_EMAIL/BOBBY_CLI_PASSWORD env vars over inline flags so the password never appears in a process list or shell history.

email.description: Account email. Prefer passing via BOBBY_CLI_EMAIL env var instead of this field.

password.description: Account password. Prefer passing via BOBBY_CLI_PASSWORD env var instead of this field — never log or echo this value.

profile.description: Named credential profile to write instead of the default ~/.bobby-cli/credentials.json (see specs/10-spec-credential-profiles.md). Only letters, numbers, "-", "_". Omit for the default single-machine identity.

tools.name: auth_show
tools.description: Show the current login's metadata (email, tenant, token label/id, scopes, timestamps). Never returns the raw API token. Use this to check whether auth_login is needed before calling a memory_* tool.

profile.description: Named credential profile to read instead of the default (see specs/10-spec-credential-profiles.md). Omit for the default single-machine identity.

tools.name: auth_forget
tools.description: Delete the local credential file. Local-only — does not revoke the token server-side. Rarely needed by an agent; mainly for a human resetting their own machine's login.

profile.description: Named credential profile to delete instead of the default (see specs/10-spec-credential-profiles.md). Omit for the default single-machine identity.

tools.name: memory_show
tools.description: List recent memories, chronological, optionally filtered by tags (matches any — OR). Requires a prior auth_login.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags to filter by — matches entries having any of them (OR, see specs/03-spec-commands.md)

profile.description: Named credential profile to read instead of the default (see specs/10-spec-credential-profiles.md). Omit for the default single-machine identity.

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Semantically search saved memories by query text, optionally filtered by tags (matches any — OR). Requires a prior auth_login.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags to filter by — matches entries having any of them (OR)

profile.description: Named credential profile to read instead of the default (see specs/10-spec-credential-profiles.md). Omit for the default single-machine identity.

tools.name: memory_remember
tools.description: Save a new memory with optional comma-separated tags. Requires a prior auth_login. `text` is optional: if omitted, the executor must pipe the content via stdin instead of a positional arg (this command reads stdin when no argument is given) — omit both the arg and the invocation template's {text} placeholder in that case, don't substitute an empty string.

text.description: Memory content to save. If omitted, provide content via stdin instead.

profile.description: Named credential profile to write against instead of the default (see specs/10-spec-credential-profiles.md). Omit for the default single-machine identity.

tools.name: memory_append
tools.description: Append additional context to an existing memory entry by ID. Requires a prior auth_login.

id.description: ID of the memory entry to append to

profile.description: Named credential profile to write against instead of the default (see specs/10-spec-credential-profiles.md). Omit for the default single-machine identity.

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.description: Delete a memory entry by ID. Requires a prior auth_login.

id.description: ID of the memory entry to delete

profile.description: Named credential profile to write against instead of the default (see specs/10-spec-credential-profiles.md). Omit for the default single-machine identity.
